He specializes in Sports Medicine (Sports Orthopaedic Surgeon), Arthroscopy, and Arthroplasty (Joint Replacement). He is dedicated to providing advanced care for shoulder, elbow, and knee injuries.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Will the doctor immediately recommend surgery?** No. Surgery is only advised when absolutely necessary. We always explore non-surgical routes first, such as targeted physiotherapy, lifestyle changes, and pain-relief injections.
- **What is the difference between open and "keyhole" (arthroscopic) surgery?** Keyhole surgery uses tiny incisions, meaning minimal blood loss, less pain, and a very quick discharge, commonly used for knee ligaments or shoulder problems. Open surgery is a standard method for complex fractures and total joint replacements.
- **Can I get a second opinion on my condition?** Absolutely. Seeking a second opinion is a very common and respected practice, especially when considering surgical procedures.
- **More FAQs**: [https://drniharmodi.com/faqs](https://drniharmodi.com/faqs)
